item.title: Excel to R date time conversion
item.description: I am working with an excel data set that I download from a companies website and am needing to pull just the date from a date time string provided. The issue I am running into is when I have R read the data set, the date time values are being read numerically, such as 45767, which to my understanding is days from origin which is 1899-12-30 for excel. I am struggling to get R to convert this numeric value to a date value and adjust for the differences in origins, can anyone provide me with a chunk of code that can process this properly or instruction on how to deal with this issue?
